grants.name: Verizon Small Business Digital Ready Grant
grants.eligibility: For-profit small businesses located in the United States; applicant must be 18+ and complete any two free modules, coaching sessions, or community events on the platform to unlock the application. Priority given to historically under-resourced and minority entrepreneurs.
grants.description: Provides $10,000 in non-dilutive capital alongside complimentary operational courses. It is a fantastic fit for Fast Apparel to fund digital marketing and automate e-commerce storefront workflows while completing free courses on supply chain and lean operations.

grants.name: The Amber Grant
grants.deadline: Rolling monthly (Last day of each month: October 31, November 30, December 31, 2026)
grants.eligibility: At least 50% women-owned businesses based in the United States or Canada, ranging from idea-stage ventures to established operating small businesses.
grants.description: A prestigious, long-running monthly grant recognizing passion and authentic entrepreneurial storytelling. Fast Apparel is an ideal candidate by highlighting community impact, high-quality custom apparel production, and allocating the funds toward upgraded printing equipment.

grants.name: Small Business Growth Fund
grants.eligibility: U.S.-based for-profit small businesses with under $1,000,000 in gross annual revenue, a demonstrated commitment to their customers/community, and a clear plan to achieve a defined business milestone.
grants.description: High-impact capital program that awards milestone-driven funding to underrepresented entrepreneurs and micro-manufacturers. Fast Apparel can submit a proposal focused on expanding in-house custom print capacity and fulfilling bulk orders for local organizations.

grants.name: Galaxy Grant
grants.eligibility: U.S.-based women and minority small business owners or entrepreneurs at any stage; free entry with no application fee.
grants.description: A rapid, streamlined 501(c)(3) grant specifically targeting women and minority entrepreneurs to overcome initial capital hurdles. It is a quick win for Fast Apparel to secure immediate non-dilutive cash flow for Q4 holiday blank garment stock and ink supplies.

grants.name: HerRise MicroGrant
grants.deadline: Rolling monthly (Last day of each month: October 31, November 30, December 31, 2026)
grants.eligibility: United States-registered for-profit small businesses that are at least 51% owned by women of color, with annual gross revenues under $1,000,000.
grants.description: Provides targeted monthly micro-grants directly to women-of-color founders navigating growth and working capital bottlenecks. Fast Apparel can utilize this grant for immediate shop consumables (DTF films, inks) and targeted B2B customer acquisition campaigns.
